summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) announcing that it will release second quarter 2026 financial results before market open on October 19, 2026, with a management webcast and Q&A the same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deadline is stated. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; the only watch item is earnings content and any guidance update.
